title: Causal-prior-constrained deep learning for rapid-intensification warning of western North Pacific tropical cyclones
summary: Masked PCMCI+ learned cyclone dependencies that informed a causal-prior forecast model; the source reports associations from 522 storms and a forward 2020–2024 holdout, with the graph’s added forecast skill concentrated near its estimation period. This is the result-bearing preprint version dated 2026-10-29; peer-review status is not established by the reviewed source.
